item.title: Brysk 0.1.0-alpha.1
item.description:
Initial alpha release of Brysk, a Rust file manager extensively reworked and extended for macOS. Early software: expect rough edges and report issues.
- Native macOS integration, Command shortcuts, menus, dialogs, sharing and permission onboarding. - Tabs, split panes, multiple views, Finder-style file operations and drag previews. - DirectLook previews for images, video, PDFs, text and archives, with sharper image loading. - Fast name search, asynchronous listing and thumbnails, and memory/performance improvements. - Optional Finder Dock-click replacement that works after Quit through a small background helper. - Signed in-app updates, standard ⌘Q to Quit, and HyperSearch shortcut/focus fixes.
Download: Developer ID-signed and notarized universal DMG for Apple silicon and Intel. Requires macOS 13 or later.
Based on rustyfiles by Özer Güzel, with extensive macOS-specific changes. See the README for features and known limits.
